68697bb0cabf.content:
721 元朗襲擊事件發生七年，至今 69 人被捕、22 人被控，數字與 2023 年相同，即過去三年再沒人因事件被捕或被控。22 名被告中，包括前立法會議員林卓廷在內的 8 名非白衣人暴動罪成，判囚 25 個月至 37 個月；其中三名被告已刑滿出獄，另有四名被告料於今年 8 月底刑滿獲釋。至於同涉 47 人案、披露游乃強受廉署調查案服刑的林卓廷，料最快 2030 年 1 月獲釋。 721 相關報道

過去三年無人被捕被控 廉署「仍在調查」相關投訴

警方回覆《集誌社》查詢，指就 721 事件，目前已拘捕 69 人，年齡介乎 18 至 87 歲，其中 22 人被控暴動， 14 人同被控串謀有意圖而傷人，21 人被定罪和判刑、一人上訴得直。相關數字與 2023 年相同，意味過去三年沒有新拘捕或檢控。案件調查進度如何、是否已結案？警方稱會繼續搜證，作出全面及深入調查。

曾成立特別調查小組，專責處理與反修例有關的懷疑貪污個案的廉政公署，包括 721 相關的投訴。《集誌社》查詢有關調查是否已結案、相關進度和時間表等，署方指個案「仍在調查」，不會作任何評論，又表示會依法按既定程序處理所有個案，亦會向審查貪污舉報諮詢委員會匯報、接受監察。

721 元朗襲擊七年，8 名暴動罪成的非白衣人中，三人已刑滿獲釋，有四人料於今年 8 月底出獄；至於時任立法會議員涉另三案，預期最快 2030 年才刑滿。（資料相片）

8 名非白衣人暴動罪成 判囚 25 個月至 37 個月

被控的 22 人當中，8 名非白衣人全部原審罪成。首宗案件中，時任立法會議員林卓廷、庾家豪、陳永晞、葉鑫昇、鄺浩林、尹仲明及楊朗，被指元朗站暴動，2024 年 12 月被裁定暴動罪成，去年 2 月判囚 25 個月至 37 個月。法官陳廣池裁決時拒納被告是自衛、調停衝突等說法，指林卓廷到場是抽政治油水、「拱火澆油」，其他人射水等是挑釁及激化衝突。

第二宗非白衣人案中，會計師何贊琦被指在元朗英龍圍與白衣人對抗，2024 年 4 月被裁暴動罪成，是首宗非白衣人罪成案件，判監 33 個月。法官李慶年裁決時指，即使白衣人曾在地鐵車廂內暴力對待市民，黑衣人也不應主動在站內「非法集結」，與村民對峙對抗：「黑衣人一方以暴力還擊，有道理也變成沒有道理，甚至出現歪理，造成以暴易暴，違理違法。」

721 元朗襲擊中，14 名白衣人被控暴動、串謀傷人等罪名，其中 13 人罪成，一人上訴得直獲撤罪。（資料相片）

三人已出獄 四人料今年 8 月底獲釋

8 名被白衣人被告中，同案被判囚 25 個月的葉鑫昇、28 個月的尹仲明，另案被判囚的何贊琦，已先後於今年刑滿出獄。其中，葉鑫昇在 2016 年考獲註冊社工資格，服務長者，但於 2024 獲被社工註冊局通知不獲續牌。而尹仲明當日目睹閘外有黑衣男士被多人毆打，掟出一個膠樽，又在白衣人入閘後到控制室拍門求助而未獲回應。

同案的庾家豪、陳永晞、楊朗、鄺浩林被判囚 31 個月，假設獲三分一行為良好扣減，將於今年 8 月底刑滿獲釋。

而前立法會議員林卓廷，在 721 案中被判囚 37 個月。他另涉 47 人案中被判囚 81 個月、披露游乃強受廉署調查案判監四個月；假設 721 和披露調查案兩案的刑期均獲三分一行為良好扣減，連同 47 人案的刑期，他預期最快 2030 年 1 月才能獲釋。至於 2019 年 7 月「光復屯門公園」遊行後，林卓廷被指要求他人刪去 7.1 示威者相片，最初被裁定妨礙司法公正罪脫，其後遭律政司上訴，案件今年六月初聆訊，法官押後在 6 個月內裁決。

根據司法機構網頁，庾家豪、陳永晞、楊朗、鄺浩林、林卓廷五人提出上訴，上訴庭排期於 2027 年 2 月 2 月處理申請。

13 名白衣人罪成囚 3 年半至 7 年

至於 14 名白衣人，13 人原審罪成，判囚 3 年半至 7 年；其中被告蔡立基上訴得直獲撤罪，另一名被告王志榮原審無罪後、律政司上訴得直，改裁罪成。

Although iOS 27 is already the main focus of preview software, Apple is still preparing the next iPhone update, iOS 26.6. Apple has released the first candidate version of iOS 26.6. The iOS 26.6 beta has been in testing since late May.

iOS 26.6 Features and Changes

So far we have discovered two notable changes in the iOS 26.6 beta.

First, an adjustment to the upper limit on the number of contacts that can be blocked. Second, a new iPhone anti-theft feature appears to be in development.

This update may also involve preparations for Spotlight indexing on iPhone and iPad, so that Siri AI can use it in iOS 27. Today's release candidate confirms this for the first time in the public release notes.

We expect there won't be many more new features and changes, as all focus has now shifted to iOS 27.

Apple's next major software update will arrive in September, by which time Apple will have been continuously refining iOS 27 throughout the summer.

iOS 26.6 will be the next release, following the iOS 26 launched last fall and its subsequent updates.

Last year, iOS 18.6 beta 1 was released after iOS 26 beta 1, meaning that iOS 26.6 is on a slightly earlier schedule than Apple's 2025 release cycle.

bef0c8faaa95.content:
Apple just released the iOS 26.6 RC version along with its companion updates. Apple's official release notes confirm a new feature has been added to prepare users' iPhones for iOS 27.

Apple will begin Spotlight indexing work starting with iOS 26.6, getting iPhones ready for iOS 27

It is uncommon for Apple to explicitly mention future software updates in the release notes of a new version.

However, this has indeed happened today with the release of iOS 26.6 RC.

Below are the official release notes for iOS 26.6:

iOS 26.6 is primarily a bug fix and security update, as the beta versions revealed virtually no new features.

Nevertheless, the mention of Spotlight indexing work is worth noting.

When the iOS 27 beta was first released last month, developers found that iPhones spent a long time performing indexing work, with the process often lasting a week or even longer in many cases.

It turns out Apple does not want users to experience the same situation again when iOS 27 is publicly released this fall.

Instead, Apple is completing most of the indexing work in advance through iOS 26.6, thereby providing a smoother experience for iOS 27.

Therefore, if you notice your iPhone performing Spotlight indexing after installing iOS 26.6, this is expected, as the new Siri and Spotlight overhaul in iOS 27 will benefit from this preparatory work.

Apple 正為 macOS 26.6 推出首個開發者及公開測試候選版本，正式版發佈在即。以下為新功能介紹。

首個 macOS 26.6 候選版本開始推送

經過五個開發者及公開測試版後，Apple 現正推出 macOS 26.6 首個候選版本，最快可能於下週發佈正式更新。

熟悉測試週期的讀者應該知道，macOS 26.6 的新功能相當少，主要集中在錯誤修正及效能改進。

不過，對於打算在今年稍後升級至 macOS 27 Golden Gate 的用戶而言，今次更新可能包含一項重要功能。

iOS 26.6 候選版本的發佈說明指出，系統已「優化 Spotlight 索引以準備迎接 iOS 27」，因此 macOS 26.6 很大機會作出同樣調整。待 Apple 發佈 macOS 26.6 候選版本的更新說明後，我們將更新本文。

話雖如此，我們正審視今次版本，若發現任何值得留意之處將會回報。macOS 26.6 候選版本的版本號為 25G70。

iOS 27 beta 4 詳情

iOS 27 beta 4 而家已經可以畀開發者 beta 測試員下載，build 編號係 23G71。

你可以打開「設定」app，揀「一般」，再揀「軟件更新」嚟安裝更新。之後喺「Beta 更新」入面揀「iOS 27 開發者 Beta」。

同任何 beta 版本一樣，我哋唔建議喺主力使用嘅 iPhone 上安裝 iOS 27 beta 4，因為可能會出現效能問題。喺 Apple 趕到秋季正式推出之前，你要有心理準備面對 bugs、電池續航差異、app 兼容性挑戰以及其他唔完善嘅地方。

iOS 27 beta 4：有咩新嘢？

以下係我哋至今喺 iOS 27 beta 4 發現嘅部分改動。

  • Siri AI 喺用 Dynamic Island 或者喺主畫面向下滑動叫醒 Siri 時，新增咗一個「啟動畫面」。
  • 今個 beta 修正咗 beta 3 引入嘅景深效果 bug。雖然玩得開心，但始終要修返。

仲搵到其他嘢？歡迎傳電郵畀我哋：tips@9to5mac.com。

唔係每部 iPhone 都用到晒 iOS 27 所有功能。今次更新支援 iPhone 11 及之後型號，以及 iPhone SE 2 或更新嘅型號，但 Siri AI 同其他 Apple Intelligence 功能就需要較新嘅硬件。

iOS 27 beta 4 was released today, and according to Macworld, it contains code that may be related to a brand-new iPhone Ultra feature: dual batteries.

Macworld discovered code in iOS 27 beta 4 referencing an iPhone equipped with multiple batteries.

Earlier this month, Weibo leaker "Digital Chat Station" revealed that Apple's upcoming iPhone Ultra is very likely to feature two separate internal batteries rather than a single battery.

Today, with the release of iOS 27 beta 4, we have stronger evidence to support this leaker's claims.

We have previously found several clues related to the iPhone Ultra in the iOS 27 code, including the upcoming foldable iPhone and models equipped with multiple screens.

Now, combined with today's newly discovered code referencing an iPhone equipped with multiple batteries.

According to a regulatory document, the capacities of the two batteries are 1,921mAh and 2,962mAh respectively, totaling 4,883mAh.

All of this corroborates earlier reports about the iPhone Ultra, which is expected to debut in early September.

iOS 26.6 即將為 iPhone 用戶推出。以下是你需要了解的所有關於此次更新的資訊，以及為何它比你想像中更重要。

iOS 26.6 詳情

Apple 於 5 月 26 日發佈了首個 iOS 26.6 beta 版本，其後陸續推出四個 beta 予開發者及公開 beta 測試者。今天，Apple 發佈了 iOS 26.6 候選版本（RC），意味著正式向所有用戶推出的日子即將來臨。

iOS 26.6 新增功能

Apple 現時已將焦點轉移至 iOS 27，因此 iOS 26.6 對 iPhone 用戶而言並非一個重大更新。然而，它確實帶來了一項非常重要的改動，為今年秋季推出的 iOS 27 更新打好基礎。

Siri AI 是 iOS 27 的旗艦功能，該功能需要為你的 iPhone 重新建立索引。這個過程會在你繼續使用 iPhone 時於背景進行。

iOS 27 將於今年秋季正式向所有用戶推出。在此之前，Apple 表示 iOS 26.6 會「優化」你 iPhone 的 Spotlight 索引，為 iOS 27 做好準備。這意味著當你今年稍後更新至 iOS 27 時，索引建立過程將會更快。

以下為 iOS 26.6 的完整發佈說明：「此更新包括錯誤修正、安全更新，並優化 Spotlight 索引，為 iOS 27 做好準備。」

除該項 iOS 27 優化外，iOS 26.6 在新功能方面著墨不多。是次更新新增了一個提示，當你封鎖過多聯絡人時便會顯示。iOS 26.6 的程式碼亦顯示 Apple 正在開發一項新的防搶奪 iPhone 功能，但該功能似乎不會隨本次更新一同推出。

Apple 尚未公佈 iOS 26.6 包含的安全修正詳情。當更新正式向公眾發佈後，相關修正內容將會刊登於 Apple 網站。

Apple 何時會發佈 iOS 26.6？

既然 Apple 已發佈 iOS 26.6 RC，預計最終版本將於未來兩星期內正式向所有用戶推出。以下是 Apple 過去推出各個 .6 更新的時間：

As vibe coding becomes more popular, the number of new apps on the App Store is skyrocketing, doubling in the first half of 2026, but downloads only grew by 2%. Here's the details.

Downloads are not keeping up with the growth of new apps on the App Store

A report published today by The New York Times cites new data from Sensor Tower that shows the number of new apps on the App Store doubled in the first half of 2026, while downloads only grew by 2%:

The NYT's report also highlights two developers who have been pushing vibe-coded apps on the App Store: Marco Pérez, who is planning to leave JPMorgan next month to build apps full-time, and David Svensson, who launched 11 niche apps in the last five months and treats vibe coding as a hobby rather than a business.

Excerpts from the report:

Pérez is a Chicago-based software engineer who had never built a mobile app before. He spent five weeks during the winter tinkering with "vibe coding" AI tools to make a prototype, and then another two weeks to get the app ready for the App Store. That app, called InfoDrizzle, has done decently well, with 1,300 downloads so far and a profit of around $500. Pérez's next app did even better. In May, he shipped Stampa, a scrapbooking app that turns photos into digital stamps, in about a week. Stampa has since been downloaded 20,000 times and earned about $3,000 in profit.

Apple spokesperson Peter Ajemian also commented on another impact of the flood of submissions to the App Store in response to the NYT: there have been reports the App Store's review process has come under strain as a result.

Ajemian said "Apple has consistently been able to review 90% of app submissions within 48 hours," and added that Apple is "thrilled to see a new generation of developers using the latest tools to build and ship apps faster than ever before."

He also noted that regardless of whether or not an app is built using vibe coding, "all apps must meet the same high-quality, privacy, and security standards that our users have come to trust."

每年 Apple 都會為旗下最新 iPhone 準備全新晶片。不過今年秋季 iPhone 18 Pro 及 iPhone Ultra 搭載的 A20 Pro 晶片，聽起來將格外與眾不同。以下為其兩項備受矚目的重大升級。

#1：A20 Pro 將成為首款採用 2 奈米製程的 iPhone 晶片

Apple 每代晶片都會帶來提升眾所周知，但不同年份的升級幅度有高有低，而全新的 A20 Pro 預料將會是特別突出的一代。

這是因為 A20 Pro 將採用台積電全新的 2 奈米製程來製造晶片。

由現有的 3 奈米製程升級至 2 奈米，代表 A20 Pro 在相近晶片面積下，可提供更強效能與更高能源效率。

每次製程技術出現顯著突破，結果都會如此。這正是 Apple 多年來提前部署，務求取得台積電最尖端製程的原因。這有助公司在 iPhone、iPad、Mac 等產品的晶片上保持領先優勢。

目前未知 Apple 將集中改善 A20 Pro 的哪些方面，但受惠於 2 奈米製程，Apple 今次將比以往擁有更大發揮空間。

#2：改用晶圓級多晶片模組封裝 帶來更大效能提升

除 2 奈米製程帶來的優勢外，A20 Pro 預計還會憑藉一項名為「晶圓級多晶片模組」（WMCM）的封裝技術革新，獲得另一項獨特升級。

以下由我的同事 Marcus 為大家詳細講解：

Apple 將首次在 iPhone 處理器上採用晶圓級多晶片模組（WMCM）封裝技術。WMCM 可在晶圓階段便將系統單晶片（SoC）及 DRAM 等不同元件整合，再切割成獨立晶片。技術上，晶片之間毋須中介層或基板互連，既能改善散熱，亦有助提升訊號完整性。換言之，Apple 下一代晶片不僅因 N2 製程而更小、更省電，更會在物理上更貼近內建記憶體，從而提升 AI 運算及高效能遊戲等工作的表現，並有望進一步降低功耗。

配備 WMCM 封裝的 A20 Pro，預計將在 AI 任務上表現特別出色。這並不令人意外，皆因 iOS 27 將大幅以 AI 為核心。

After the massive real estate expansion in the South Bay area in 2025, Apple is once again expanding its business presence in Sunnyvale. Details below.

Apple continues to expand its business footprint

According to a report by The Mercury News (republished by AppleInsider), Apple has agreed to lease an office building of 125,800 square feet at 580 North Mathilda Avenue in Sunnyvale.

This deal is Apple's first major real estate move in the area in 2026. In 2025, Apple spent more than US$1 billion expanding its presence in the South Bay area, making it a particularly busy year.

These include the purchase of three buildings at the Cupertino Gateway for US$166.9 million, the acquisition of two buildings at Mathilda Commons in Sunnyvale for US$350 million, as well as the purchase of four adjacent buildings at Mathilda Campus for US$365 million.

Apple subsequently invested another US$216 million in two buildings on Stevens Creek Boulevard in Cupertino, bringing its Bay Area expansion in 2025 to more than 1.5 million square feet of office and laboratory space in total.

Returning to Apple's new lease, The Mercury News noted that this deal comes as office leasing activity in the South Bay area begins to pick up, with vacancy rates improving compared to the previous quarter and the same period last year:

According to a report by Colliers, the office vacancy rate in the South Bay area was 14.1% in the second quarter of 2026. Colliers defines the market as covering Santa Clara County and Fremont. This represents an improvement from the 14.8% vacancy rate in the fourth quarter of October to December 2025, as well as the 16.2% vacancy rate in the second quarter of 2025.

「波媽」之後嘗試向傳媒講述事件，再有港鐵職員上前，稱港鐵範圍內未經申請不得採訪，又指她說粗口，要求出示身分證給予警告，雙方再發生口角。「波媽」質疑為何要向港鐵職員出示身分證，又謂自己是北方人不知道何謂粗口，稱「習主席講嘅，唔可以販毒，唔可以食毒」。港鐵職員其後要求警方協助，「波媽」多次表示可配合警方，但拒絕向港鐵職員出示身分證。

李盈姿抱西瓜到場被搜查

傍晚約 6 時，曾涉 23 條被捕的李盈姿帶同西瓜及據稱是 721 施襲者的相片到元朗站，不久後，她和同樣抱著西瓜的陳先生被警員帶到通往東頭村出口的天橋搜查，警員從李盈姿背囊搜出一個寫著「搜乜撚嘢」的文件夾。李指「七年前有咁多警察就好，七年前呢幾位（搜查的警員）都好細個，唔知佢哋知唔知咩事呢？」至約 6 時 50 分，李仍在被搜查當中，陳先生則二度被搜查後獲放行。

Reliable sources with a track record of accurate leaks have revealed that next year may see the launch of the largest-screened iPhone in history.

Supply chain sources indicate that Apple is testing a new display, which could potentially be used in a new iPhone model whose designation is still unknown...

The Naming Mystery of Next Year's Flagship iPhone

2027 marks the 20th anniversary of the iPhone launch, and there has been widespread belief that Apple is secretly developing a major new product. The company is expected to come very close to its long-standing design vision that year — that of the iPhone becoming "a single sheet of glass".

Some speculate that Apple may release a special 20th anniversary edition iPhone, similar to what was done with the iPhone X. However, more recent reports suggest that this groundbreaking new design will debut directly as next year's Pro models (namely the iPhone 19 Pro and Pro Max).

A third possibility is that Apple, to mark the anniversary, will skip directly from the iPhone 18 to the iPhone 20.

The Largest iPhone Display Ever

Leaker Digital Chat Station (DCS) said that supply chain sources indicate Apple is currently testing the largest iPhone display ever. However, the size increase is relatively modest compared to the existing iPhone 17 Pro Max, which features a 6.9-inch screen.

In other words, they believe Apple will use a "7-inch display" as a marketing highlight.

DCS did not provide any information on the purpose of the new display (assuming Apple actually follows through with it), but speculated it may be used in next year's iPhone Pro Max — regardless of the final model name.

9to5Mac's View

Apple tests many different things, but most of them never make it to market, so even if this display truly exists as a prototype within the company's supply chain, that does not necessarily mean it will end up in an iPhone.

However, if the company's goal is to create the look of "a single sheet of glass," being able to boast the largest display ever seems like a reasonable marketing strategy.

未簽信業主接獲銀行來電稱已揀方案 翌日指銀行搞錯

宏福苑業主向政府提交接受收購建議信件的首個限期 6.30 結束，宏志閣因逾 75% 業主願賣業權，納入長遠居住方案，政府稱截至本月 16 日，已與 769 戶簽署買賣協議。

居於宏志閣中層的陳先生，於 2017 年購入單位，尚餘約 200 多萬按揭，至今未有簽署並交回「接受收購建議信件」。他上周一（13 日）向《集誌社》表示，當天接獲處理其按揭的渣打銀行職員致電，稱早前獲政府通知，他選擇了「Plan B」、即取錢選新居屋的方案。

陳先生立即表示，自己從無簽署並交回收購信件，質疑搞錯了，想核對資料；職員說出其地址，重申是政府通知，並解釋賣業權後的按揭安排等，又表示會記錄陳先生情況並告知上司。

陳先生翌日（14 日）收到同一位職員致電，指向銀行查詢及檢查政府給予的資料後，發現是銀行「搞錯咗」，據政府資料他並沒有選擇「Plan B」，並向他表示「唔好意思」。

憂「被代表」、資訊不足無回覆

陳先生向《集誌社》表示，一直沒簽署收購建議信，是因就維修費安排、保險賠償、會否再維修讓居民返宏志居住等，當局一直未有答覆，太多不明朗情況下，現階段不能決定賣業權，「唔係你話賣我就賣」。他認為，長遠居住方案只能抽籤決定，房屋亦以組裝合成建築、質素參差，不吸引他優先賣樓。

早前公布超過 75% 宏志閣業主願接受收購後，陳先生已有懷疑，指街坊群組有不少人不賣，認為相關數據都是「佢自己講」、但「中間過程冇人知」，坦言「如果佢喺業主大會度投票，即時公布，咁我就相信喇」。他亦因憂慮「被代表」、斷章取義，故沒有作任何回覆。

「無論我點決定，都係要賣畀佢」

對於銀行第一次來電，陳先生大感驚訝：「我冇揀過任何嘢，但政府就幫我同銀行講咗我揀咗 Plan B」，他苦笑：「即係我就係嗰 75% 囉，我成日同人講我唔係㗎、邊個係嗰 75% 呀，原來我自己就係嗰 75%，我自己做咗都唔知」。

陳先生強調，最公正是在業主大會即時投票再公布結果，惟合安表明會上不處理賣業權事宜，他質疑當局「驚即時投票就冇得兜」。他嘆這次事件讓他更覺得，「無論我點樣決定，最後政府都係用佢嘅方法令我要賣畀佢，只不過係我早啲賣定遲啲賣。」

就翌日銀行來電指「搞錯」，仍未能完全釋除陳先生疑慮，他說「佢咁講，我咁聽。」

業主大會後更不欲賣樓

陳先生明白方案已不會有變，但始終希望得知，就未有燒毀的宏志閣，能否有維修讓居民回去住的選項 ，「始終一刻未公布，我哋都有機會真係可以維修到」；又指若政府最終立法收購，他始終要賣，但若政府不買其業權，「你都要畀我返上去住」。

周日（19 日）舉行業主大會，陳先生質疑合法只是「交功課」、迴避居民問題，「只係講佢自己想講嗰啲」。陳先生說，業主大會後更加不會賣業權予政府，因本可用保險賠償維修宏志，但出售業權後，保險會賠予政府。

房屋局：收信後會將未還按揭個案轉銀行

《集誌社》上周一（13 日）向房屋局查詢，對事件是否知悉、是否涉局方出錯、有否同類事件及影響早前公布的數據、如何令居民信服等。房屋局未有正面回應，僅於昨（20 日）回覆指，根據金管局和銀行公會今年 3 月公布，金管局、銀行公會及銀行業界會設立溝通平台，包括透過房屋局統籌的「解說專隊」了解宏福苑居民具體需要，並為每宗個案提供合適協助。

局方指，就此一直與銀行公會及參與宏福苑單位按揭的銀行保持緊密溝通，在收到業主簽妥的「接受收購建議信件」後，解說隊會據業主信件中提供的按揭資料，就仍有未償還按揭的個案，按照信件所載收集個人資料聲明，將有關個案轉介至承按銀行，讓銀行可派專責職員聯絡業主，以助理解業界為協助業主而提供的特別按揭安排，及提供適切協助。

渣打：不評論個別個案，體恤原則跟進

渣打銀行發言人則於上周二（14 日）回覆指，不評論個別客戶個案，指一直設有專責團隊，按宏福苑受影響業主客戶的個別需要，以體恤原則跟進，並確保客戶資料獲妥善處理。

宏福苑首批收購限期 6.30 結束，財政司副司長黃偉綸日前表示，截至本月 16 日為止，已有 1,786 戶簽署並交回「接受收購建議信件」，佔總住戶超過九成，當中有約 43%、即 769 戶已簽買賣協議。
